name: Death Natural
overview: Scripture portrays natural death as a state of rest and release from earthly troubles, where both the weary and the oppressed find peace, as illustrated in Job 3:17-18. It emphasizes the impartiality of death, leveling all ranks so that the small and great alike are freed from their earthly bonds (Job 3:19). This depiction aligns with the broader biblical understanding of death as a consequence of sin and a temporary state from which all shall be raised, ultimately conquered and abolished by Christ.
